title: Silent divergence is the only reputational crime; Phase A does not fine
subject: silent-divergence
ratio: (1) The only reputational crime is silent divergence: departing from a binding rule without running the overruling or distinguishing protocol. (2) This makes the cheap path (ignore the registry) the expensive path, which is the entire point of a currency. (3) The crime is recorded as doctrine now; its reputational PRICE is Phase B material. Phase A counts and displays; it does not fine. (4) Divergence is observable only where a record or a relation is published: no verb parses free prose, so this record imposes no new detection duty and authorizes no new detector.
scope_conditions: any departure from a binding rule that does not run the overruling or distinguishing protocol
revisit_trigger: Revisit when a reputational price for silent divergence is proposed, or when any divergence detector is promoted from pass to gate
validity_conditions: divergence is recorded only where a record or a relation is published; no verb parses free prose for it
